# Source Audit: Edward Tallman (KPQ5-V9F)

No project was found at `/project`, so this is a read-only report — nothing was written.

---

## Source Key

| Label | Collection | Record ID |
|---|---|---|
| **FG** | Find a Grave Index | QVKW-7BXX |
| **TOMB** | Tombstone memory | 7349489 |
| **C1850** | US Census 1850 | MCTB-KBM |
| **NYS1865** | NY State Census 1865 | QVNJ-JDJD |
| **C1870** | US Census 1870 | M8N9-JJL |
| **NYS1875** | NY State Census 1875 | VT8T-XYW |
| **C1880** | US Census 1880 | MZ83-SG1 |
| **C1910** | US Census 1910 | M5W8-LDP |
| **VR-A** | Vermont Vital Records 1760–1954 | 2V7M-JMY |
| **VR-B** | Vermont Vital Records 1760–2008 | KN9R-2KJ |
| **VDB** | Vermont Deaths and Burials (indexed as "Edward Mollman") | F8R4-RYM |
| **TC** | Vermont Town Clerk record | QPQ2-58BX |
| **Child/spouse records** | Vermont vital & death records 1890–1948 | (multiple, see below) |

> *Not checkable:* Burlington Free Press clip (no record link); Vermont 1760–1954 entry XF2X-BYV (lookup error). Images were read from index text only where no image tool was available.

---

## Correlation Table

| Conclusion | On Profile | What Sources Say |
|---|---|---|
| **Birth (year/range)** | 30 Nov 1838 | C1850, NYS1865, VR-A, VDB: age → 1838–1839 ✓. C1880 / C1870: census drift to 1839–1841 (within tolerance). |
| **Birth (exact date)** | 30 Nov 1838 | FG: **31 Jan 1839 [CONFLICT]**. TOMB: age 74y 6m 16d at death 16 Aug 1913 → **31 Jan 1839 [CONFLICT]**. No source gives 30 Nov 1838. |
| **Birth place** | Peru, Clinton, New York | VR-B: "Peru" ✓. Censuses: "New York" ✓ (by containment). |
| **Christening** | — | No source addresses one. |
| **Death date** | 16 Aug 1913 | FG, TOMB, VR-A, VR-B, VDB, TC: all agree ✓. |
| **Death place** | Burlington, Chittenden, Vermont | VR-A, VR-B, VDB: "Burlington" ✓. TC: "Vermont" ✓. FG/TOMB: no death place. |
| **Burial** | Whallon's Bay Cemetery, Essex NY | FG: Whallons Bay Cemetery, Essex NY ✓. No source gives a burial date. |
| **Residence 1850** | Au Sable, Clinton NY | C1850: Au Sable ✓. |
| **Residence 1865** | *(not on profile)* | NYS1865: Essex — gap on profile. |
| **Residence 1870–1880** | Essex, Essex NY | C1870, NYS1875, C1880: all agree ✓. |
| **Residence 1910** | Perinton, Monroe NY | C1910: Perinton ✓. |
| **Father** | Joseph Tallman (KPQ5-V4H) | C1850: Joseph household ✓. VDB: "Joseph …Allman" ✓. VR-A: "Jas Tallman" **[CONFLICT]**. VR-B: "Joo Tallman" **[CONFLICT]**. |
| **Mother** | Jane Patterson (alias Hannah) | C1850: "Hannah" (born Canada 1812) ✓. VR-A, VR-B, VDB: "Jane Patterson" ✓. |
| **Spouse 1: Mary (~1860)** | Mary (9VCF-GCG), abt 1860, Essex | NYS1865: Edward + Mary in household ✓. No marriage record attached. |
| **Spouse 2: Clarissa Wade (~1866)** | Clarissa Minerva Wade (KPQ5-HL4) | C1870, NYS1875: Clarissa in household ✓. 8+ Vermont records 1890–1948 name her as wife/mother ✓. No marriage record attached; date unsupported. |
| **Child: Mary (~1860)** | b. abt 30 Nov 1860, d. 1863 | No source addresses her. Birth day/month mirrors Edward's profile date — origin unknown. |
| **Child: Caroline (Jan 1863)** | d. 1864 | No source addresses her. |
| **Child: Lilly (Jun 1865)** | b. June 1865 | NYS1865: "Lilly," born 1865 ✓. |
| **Child: Francis Minerva (13 Oct 1866)** | b. 13 Oct 1866 | C1870: "Francis," 1866 ✓. NYS1875: "Frances M" ✓. 1948 death rec: birth 13 Oct 1866, parents Edward + Clara Wade ✓. |
| **Child: Helen Lucretia (10 Jul 1868)** | b. 10 Jul 1868 | C1870: "Nellie," 1868 ✓. NYS1875: "Nellie L" ✓. 1943 death: birth 10 Jul 1868, parents Edward + Clacissa Wade ✓. Birth place "Peru" in KFTK-Z6N vs. profile's "Essex" (child's profile issue). |
| **Child: Phoebe Lenora (17 Mar 1870)** | b. 17 Mar 1870 | C1870: "Phebe" ✓. C1880: "Norah" **[CONFLICT — given name]**. C1910: "Phoebe E Derby," 1870 ✓. |
| **Child: Blanche Elvina (15 Jan 1873)** | b. 15 Jan 1873 | NYS1875, C1880, three 1893 marriage entries: all agree ✓. |
| **Child: Theodore Burt (15 Sep 1874)** | b. 15 Sep 1874 | NYS1875, C1880, 1895 marriage: agree ✓. |
| **Child: Orrin Jerome (14 Oct 1877)** | b. 14 Oct 1877 | C1880: 1878 (census drift). 1930 death records: 14 Oct 1878 ✓ parentage; agree. |

---

## Annotations

### 1. Conflicting Evidence

- **Birth exact date.** FG and the tombstone memory both independently give **31 Jan 1839**; the profile records 30 Nov 1838. No source supports the profile date. The tombstone arithmetic is verifiable: 74y 6m 16d before 16 Aug 1913 = 31 Jan 1839.
- **Father's given name.** VR-A gives "Jas," VR-B gives "Joo," VDB gives "Joseph." All three are 1913 death records; the informant likely could not be sure of the full name.
- **Surname misindex.** VDB indexes the subject as "Edward Mollman" — almost certainly a transcription garble of "Tallman."
- **Daughter's name, 1870 vs. 1880 census.** C1870 says "Phebe" and C1880 says "Norah" for the child born 1870. These are two attached sources in direct conflict.

### 2. Consistent Patterns

- **Death date** is the best-supported fact — six independent sources agree.
- **Clarissa Wade as wife/mother** appears in the 1870/1875 censuses and more than eight Vermont records from 1890–1948 (separate collections).
- **Children's identities** are cross-confirmed across five censuses and multiple Vermont vital records.
- **Parentage (Joseph + Jane/Hannah)** is supported by the 1850 census household and three 1913 death records.

### 3. Weak or Unsupported Conclusions

| Conclusion | Issue |
|---|---|
| Birth exact date (30 Nov 1838) | Contradicted by both specific-date sources |
| Marriage to Mary (~1860) | No marriage record; date/place unsupported |
| Marriage to Clarissa (~1866) | No marriage record; date unsupported; Clarissa born 1851 → ~15 at marriage |
| Children Mary (1860) and Caroline (1863) | No source read addresses either child |
| Burial date | No source gives a burial date |
| 1865 residence | NYS1865 supports Essex, but it is not on the profile |

### 4. Overall Assessment

The profile is **well-supported** for death, most residences, parentage, Clarissa as spouse, and most children. The one clearly contested fact is the **exact birth date** — the profile's 30 Nov 1838 is unsupported while two separate sources agree on 31 Jan 1839. The two marriages lack marriage records entirely. The VDB surname misindex ("Mollman") is a transcription error in an otherwise valid record. The 1870/1880 census conflict over the daughter's given name requires separate resolution.

**Priority actions:**
1. Re-examine the tombstone image and the source of "30 Nov 1838" — the evidence strongly favors 31 Jan 1839.
2. Correct the VDB index entry (re-read the original death certificate image 3:1:3QS7-L99P-5ZTX).
3. Re-read VR-A image for the father's given name.
4. Send the Phebe/Norah conflict to the conflict-resolution workflow.
5. Consider adding an 1865 Essex residence fact from NYS1865.

args.prompt:
Examine all sources attached to Edward Tallman, FamilySearch person ID KPQ5-V9F. For each source, read the index entry and, where possible, the original image.

Then produce a correlation table with:
- One row per event conclusion (birth date, birth place, christening, death date, death place, burial, marriage date, marriage place, etc.) and per relationship conclusion (each parent, each spouse, each child).
- Column 1: The conclusion currently recorded on the FamilySearch profile (fact type + value).
- Subsequent columns: What each cited source actually says for that fact (by source label/title). Use "—" when the source does not address that fact, and flag discrepancies with a note like "[CONFLICT]".

After the table, add an annotation section covering:
1. Any conflicting evidence between sources.
2. Patterns in consistent evidence (e.g., multiple independent sources agreeing).
3. Any conclusions that have no supporting evidence or only one weak source.
4. Overall assessment of the profile's source support.

Do not write to research.json — this is a read-only audit delivered as a report to the researcher. Use the project path /project if a project exists there, otherwise operate without one.

agent_returns.text:
# Source audit: Edward Tallman (KPQ5-V9F)

No project exists at /project, so nothing was written or logged. I could read index text but could not open any original images, since I have no image tool. Each source is labelled below for the table.

**Source key**

- **FG**: Find a Grave Index, "Edward Tallman" (QVKW-7BXX). Death 16 Aug 1913, birth 31 Jan 1839, burial Whallons Bay Cemetery, Essex NY. No openable image.
- **TOMB**: Tombstone memory (7349489), transcribed text "Died Aug. 16. 1913. Æ. 74 yrs. 6 mos. 16 dys." Image not opened.
- **C1850**: US Census 1850, "Edward Tollman" in Joseph Tollman's household, Au Sable (MCTB-KBM).
- **NYS1865**: NY State Census 1865, Edward with wife Mary and daughter Lilly (QVNJ-JDJD).
- **C1870**: US Census 1870, Edward and Clarissa in the Horace Stevens household, Essex (M8N9-JJL).
- **NYS1875**: NY State Census 1875, "Edward Tollman," Essex (VT8T-XYW).
- **C1880**: US Census 1880, Edward with children, Essex ED 46 (MZ83-SG1).
- **C1910**: US Census 1910, Edward in the Chas H Derby household, Perinton NY (M5W8-LDP).
- **VR-A**: Vermont Vital Records 1760-1954, death 16 Aug 1913, Burlington (2V7M-JMY). Image available.
- **VR-B**: Vermont Vital Records 1760-2008, death 16 Aug 1913, Burlington (KN9R-2KJ). No image returned.
- **VDB**: Vermont Deaths and Burials, indexed as "Edward Mollman," death 16 Aug 1913, Burlington (F8R4-RYM). Death certificate image available.
- **TC**: Vermont Town Clerk record, death 16 August 1913, "Vermont" (QPQ2-58BX). Image available.
- **Child and spouse records** (Vermont vital and death records, 1890 to 1948): the Vermont marriage entries for Fannie (QPQV-662T, QPQX-DRDD, XFXS-8D3), Blanche (QPQL-F9N3, QPQG-F2GF, XFXS-886) and Theodore (XF4D-B9M), the Helen McIntosh death records (VNRV-QZJ, KFTK-Z6N, F8R7-NW1), the Orrin death records (2V7M-6QM, KN9R-HN1, F8RW-X4N), the Fannie 1948 death (KF5F-WMS), and the Orran marriage entry (XFXS-8Y5).

**Not checkable this run:** the Burlington Free Press funeral clip (9J22-G6F) has no record link. The lookup for XF2X-BYV ("Edward M Tollman," Vermont 1760-1954) returned an error. Image-backed sources were read from index text only.

## Correlation table

Sources are listed inside each row because one column per source (about 29) would not fit.

| Conclusion | On profile | What the sources say |
|---|---|---|
| Birth, from ages | 30 Nov 1838 | C1850 1838–1839, agrees. NYS1865 1838–1839, agrees. VR-A 1838–1839, agrees. VDB 1838–1839, agrees. C1910 1838–1839, agrees. C1880 1839–1840 and C1870 1840–1841 are census age drift within tolerance, not recorded. |
| Birth, exact date | 30 Nov 1838 | FG gives 31 Jan 1839 **[CONFLICT]**. TOMB gives age 74 yrs 6 mos 16 days at death on 16 Aug 1913, which works out to 31 Jan 1839 **[CONFLICT]**. No source read gives 30 Nov 1838. |
| Birth place | Peru, Clinton, New York | VR-B "Peru," agrees. C1850, C1870, C1880 and C1910 say "New York," agrees by containment. |
| Christening | Not on profile | No source addresses one. |
| Death date | 16 Aug 1913 | FG, TOMB, VR-A, VR-B, VDB and TC all agree. |
| Death place | Burlington, Chittenden, Vermont | VR-A, VR-B and VDB say Burlington, agrees. TC says "Vermont," agrees by containment. FG and TOMB give no death place. |
| Burial | August 1913, Whallon's Bay Cemetery, Essex NY | FG gives Whallons Bay Cemetery, Essex NY, agrees on place. No source gives a burial date. TOMB gives no cemetery. |
| Residence 1850 | Au Sable, Clinton NY | C1850 Au Sable, agrees. |
| Residence 1865 | Not on profile | NYS1865 Essex, not on profile (gap). |
| Residence 1870 | Essex, Essex NY | C1870 Essex, agrees. |
| Residence 1875 | Essex, Essex NY | NYS1875 Essex (indexed "Tollman"), agrees. |
| Residence 1880 | Essex, Essex NY | C1880 Essex ED 46, agrees. |
| Residence 1910 | Perinton, Monroe NY | C1910 Perinton, agrees. |
| Father | Joseph Tallman (KPQ5-V4H) | C1850 lists Edward as a son in Joseph's household (born Canada), agrees. VDB father "Joseph ...Allman," agrees. VR-A father "Jas Tallman" **[CONFLICT, name form]**. VR-B father "Joo Tallman" **[CONFLICT, name form]**. |
| Mother | Jane Patterson (KPQ5-VFN), alias Hannah | C1850 wife "Hannah," born Canada 1812, agrees with the profile alias. VR-A, VR-B and VDB all name "Jane Patterson," agree. |
| Spouse 1 | Mary (9VCF-GCG), marriage about 1860, Essex | NYS1865 Edward and Mary (born 1841) in one household, agrees on the pairing. No marriage record. |
| Spouse 2 | Clarissa Minerva Wade (KPQ5-HL4), marriage about 1866, Essex | C1870 Clarissa (born 1851) in household, agrees. NYS1875 "Clarissa Tollman," wife, agrees. VR records and the 1893, 1895, 1930 and 1943 entries name Edward and Clarissa/Clara Wade as parents or couple, agree. No source gives a marriage date. |
| Child: Mary (LZL8-9CJ), b. about 30 Nov 1860, d. 1863 | As profile | No source read addresses her. |
| Child: Caroline (9VCF-GCK), b. Jan 1863, d. 1864 | As profile | No source read addresses her. |
| Child: Lilly (9VCF-GC2), b. June 1865 | As profile | NYS1865 Lilly, born 1865, in Edward and Mary's household, agrees. |
| Child: Francis Minerva (KG12-K59), b. 13 Oct 1866 | As profile | C1870 "Francis," born 1866, agrees. NYS1875 "Frances M," agrees. C1880 "Fannie," born 1867, is census drift. KF5F-WMS (1948 death) gives birth 13 Oct 1866 Essex, parents Edward and Clara Wade, agrees exactly. |
| Child: Helen Lucretia (2Z3X-MXH), b. 10 Jul 1868 | As profile | C1870 "Nellie," born 1868, agrees. NYS1875 "Nellie L," agrees. C1880 "Nellie," born 1869, is census drift. KFTK-Z6N and VNRV-QZJ (1943 death, Helen L McIntosh) give birth 10 Jul 1868 and parents Edward and Clacissa Wade, agree. KFTK-Z6N gives birth place "Peru" against the profile's "Essex." |
| Child: Phoebe Lenora (LHLT-TG7), b. 17 Mar 1870 | As profile | C1870 "Phebe," born 1870, agrees. NYS1875 "Phebe L," agrees. C1880 "Norah," born 1870 **[CONFLICT, given name]** against C1870. C1910 "Phoebe E Derby," born 1870, with Edward as parent in household, agrees. |
| Child: Blanche Elvina (LZLZ-1BK), b. 15 Jan 1873 | As profile | NYS1875 "Blanch L," agrees. C1880 "Blanche," born 1873, agrees. 1893 marriage entries (QPQL-F9N3, QPQG-F2GF, XFXS-886) give Blanche Tolman, born 1873, with parents Edward and Clara/Clarisa Wade, agree. |
| Child: Theodore Burt (LHD6-27G), b. 15 Sep 1874 | As profile | NYS1875 "Theodore B," agrees. C1880 "Theodore," born 1875, is census drift. XF4D-B9M (1895 marriage) gives Theodore B. Tallman, born 1875 Essex, parents Edward and Clarissa Wade, agrees. |
| Child: Orrin Jerome (L4HT-HXS), b. 14 Oct 1877 | As profile | C1880 "Orrin," born 1878, agrees. 1930 death entries (2V7M-6QM, KN9R-KCW, F8RW-X4F) give birth 14 Oct 1878, parents Edward and Clarisa Wade, agree on parentage and day-month. XFXS-8Y5 gives "Orran Tollman," born Essex, parents Edward and Clarissa Wade, agrees. The same 1930 records give death place Burlington VT against the profile's Essex NY (child's own fact, see note below). |

## Annotation

**1. Conflicting evidence**

- **Birth exact date.** The profile's 30 Nov 1838 is contradicted by the only two exact-date sources, which agree with each other on 31 Jan 1839. The age-derived sources (1838–1839 ranges) fit either date.
- **Surname.** VDB indexes the subject as "Edward Mollman." Its parents, spouse, death date and place all fit this man.
- **Father's given name.** Three 1913 death entries give three forms: "Jas" (VR-A), "Joo" (VR-B) and "Joseph" (VDB). The profile's Joseph matches only VDB exactly.
- **Daughter's given name.** The 1870 census says "Phebe" and the 1880 census says "Norah," both for a girl born 1870. Both are census sources attached to this profile, so this is source against source. It is for the conflict workflow to settle, with no winner picked here.
- **Marriage plausibility.** The profile dates the Clarissa marriage to about 1866. Clarissa was born January 1851 per the profile and the 1870 census, so she would have been about 15. No source contradicts the date, but it needs a marriage record before it is relied on.
- **Silence in 1880.** The 1880 census gives Edward as "Married" but does not list Clarissa in the household. The census does not explain this.

**2. Consistent patterns**

- The death date and place are the best-supported facts. Six sources agree on 16 Aug 1913, including the tombstone memory and the town clerk record.
- The parents Joseph and Jane (Hannah) Patterson appear in the 1850 census household and in three 1913 death records.
- Clarissa Wade is named as spouse and mother of the children in the 1870 and 1875 censuses and in more than eight Vermont records from 1890 to 1948. These are separate collections and so independent.
- The children appear across the 1865, 1870, 1875, 1880 and 1910 censuses, and in Vermont records for the older daughters and sons.

**3. Weak or unsupported conclusions**

- **Marriage to Mary (about 1860).** Only the 1865 census supports the pairing. No marriage record is attached and the date and place are unsupported.
- **Marriage to Clarissa (about 1866).** Couple support only. No marriage record and no date.
- **Children Mary (1860) and Caroline (1863).** No source read addresses them. The profile gives Mary's birth as "about 30 November 1860," the same day and month as Edward's profile birth date. No source gives that day, so its origin is worth checking.
- **Burial.** No source gives a burial date. Only the place is supported, by FG.
- **Residence 1865.** NYS1865 supports an Essex residence the profile does not have.
- **Tagging.** FamilySearch lists no tagged sources for five residences and two marriages, even though census sources bear on the residences.

**4. Overall assessment**

The profile's parentage, death date and place, residences from 1850 to 1910, and children are well supported by independent sources. The marriages and burial date are thin. The exact birth date is the one contested fact, and the only sources that give an exact date disagree with it.

**Findings**

1. **Birth exact date: ambiguous, re-read first.** FG and the tombstone memory both point to 31 Jan 1839, against the profile's 30 Nov 1838. The kind of error cannot be told from this profile alone. Re-read the tombstone image (images/7349489.jpg) and the original Find a Grave entry, and find where the profile's 30 Nov 1838 came from. Keep the sources attached.

2. **Surname "Mollman," Vermont Deaths and Burials, 1871-1965.** Link: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F8R4-RYM. Indexing error. Every other field fits the subject, so this is a garbled surname in a good record. Re-read the death certificate (image 3:1:3QS7-L99P-5ZTX) and correct the index. Keep the source attached.

3. **Father's given name, 1913 death entries.** Links: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:2V7M-JMY (VR-A) and https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:KN9R-2KJ (VR-B). The forms "Jas" and "Joo" differ from "Joseph." Ambiguous. Re-read the VR-A image (3:1:3QS7-9979-F9ZZ). VR-B has no image, so use the Vermont death record it derives from. Keep the sources attached.

4. **Daughter's given name, 1870 and 1880 censuses.** Links: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M8N9-JJR and https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MZ83-SP9. Source against source: "Phebe" against "Norah." This goes to the conflict workflow. No winner is picked here.

**Could not check:** the funeral clip (no record link), and the Edward M Tollman Vermont 1760-1954 entry (lookup error).

**Impossible-date check:** not run, because there is no project.

**FamilySearch's profile checklist** (suggestions, not errors, not counted above):

VERIFIABILITY
- Five residences have no tagged sources.
- Two marriages have no tagged sources.

COMPLETENESS
- Two marriage dates are missing a month.

CONSISTENCY
- FamilySearch flags this birth place too, finding 3 above.

**Closing note:** Two kinds of FamilySearch storage detail were left out: repeated internal ids across records, and relationships to people outside this read. Neither needs action.

**Notes on child facts (not this profile's findings):** Helen Lucretia's birth place is "Peru" in KFTK-Z6N against the profile's "Essex." Orrin Jerome's death place is Burlington VT in the 1930 records against the profile's Essex NY. Both belong to those children's profiles.

dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.rationale: The response correctly reads and reports on most sources, but makes a critical error in the birth-date finding. The response reports the 31 Jan 1839 date from FG and TOMB as a [CONFLICT] against the profile's 30 Nov 1838, which is correct. However, the response also flags the Vermont death records (VR-A, VR-B, VDB) as conflicting on the birth date when they only provide age-derived windows (1838-1839), not exact dates. Per the per-test context, age windows containing the profile date are not conflicts and should not be reported as findings. The response incorrectly treats these age-derived windows as contradictions. Additionally, the response correctly identifies the father's name variations (Jas, Joo, Joseph) as a separate finding, which is appropriate. The surname 'Mollman' indexing error is correctly identified. Most other facts are accurately reported with proper source citations.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: The response addresses all major aspects of the delegation: it examined all attached sources, produced a comprehensive correlation table with profile conclusions versus source evidence, identified conflicting evidence, noted consistent patterns, flagged weak or unsupported conclusions, and provided an overall assessment. ## Sources Attached — 6 readable, 2 actionable findings + 1 conflict to resolve

  Supports the profile's birth year of 1814. ✓

**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**
The index records the marriage as **9 June 1845**, St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke, to Margaret Hayes. The profile records **9 June 1849**. Same couple, same parish, same day and month — only the year differs.

**Next step:** Re-read the original marriage register image to see which year is actually written there.

---

### ⚠️ Finding 2 — Indexing discrepancy: 1851 Residence

**Census of Canada East, 1851**
The index records residence as **Melbourne, Canada East**; the profile records **Sherbrooke, Canada East**. Birthplace (Ireland) matches.

**Next step:** Re-read the original 1851 census page for this household to confirm the place written by the enumerator. No image is available on FamilySearch, so the original enumeration would need to be consulted.

---

Two sources disagree on the year of death; neither is preferred here:

| Source | Death/Burial Date |
|---|---|
| Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers — burial, St. Patrick's Cemetery | 14 April **1878**, Sherbrooke |
| Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900 | 2 February **1885**, Sherbrooke |

The profile has no death fact at all (only an undated burial). **Take this to the conflict-resolution workflow** to weigh these two records against each other.

A contributor-uploaded memory ("Driscoll headstone photograph, St. Patrick's Cemetery") carries no indexed record. If the headstone is legible, the date on it may bear directly on the 1878 vs. 1885 death-year conflict.

| Priority | Action |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Conflict-resolution**: 1878 burial record vs. 1885 civil death index |
| 2 | **Re-read image**: Marriage register to verify year (1845 vs. 1849) |
| 3 | **Re-read original**: 1851 census to verify residence (Melbourne vs. Sherbrooke) |
| 4 | **Check headstone photo** for a legible death date as corroborating evidence |

### Finding 1 — Misattributed source (worst)
**Minnesota State Census, 1885**
The indexed record is for a *different* Christian Hole — born 1852 in Norway, wife Bergit, son Nils, residing in Aurdal, Otter Tail County. Christian P. Hole's profile shows him born **1875** in Norway, wife Inger, no 1885 residence. The 23-year birth gap, different wife's name, and different son rule out census drift. This record is already attached to **KD96-WX7** (Christian Hole, born 1852), where it belongs.
> **Action:** Detach this source from KD96-TV2.

**Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002**
The index records the death year as **1954**; the profile says **1945**. Name, birthplace (Norway, 1875), and death place (Erskine, Polk County) all agree — only the year conflicts. Because it is an index-only collection with no image, the original death certificate must settle it.
> **Action:** Locate the Polk County death certificate (Erskine, 1945) and check the year. If it confirms 1945, submit a correction to the FamilySearch index. Keep the source attached.

---

- **Funeral card / photograph (uploaded memory):** A contributor upload with no record ID. The 1945 funeral card citation is a lead worth following, not independent corroboration.
- **1900 US Census:** No finding — birth-year drift is within ordinary variance.
- **Sourcing gap:** Nothing in the attached sources supports the marriage.

Here is what the source-evaluation agent found for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources Audit — 4 Sources Checked, 2 Actionable Findings

### ❌ Finding 1 — Possible Indexing Error: "Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"
- The index records a death date of **10 June 1954**, but the profile shows **10 June 1945**.
- The place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota) and birth (1875, Norway) otherwise fit this man.
- **Next step:** Re-read the original death certificate to verify which year is correct. If the certificate shows 1945, use FamilySearch's correction path to fix the index. Keep the source attached while you investigate.

### ❌ Finding 2 — Misattribution: "Minnesota State Census, 1885"
- The indexed person is a Christian Hole born **1852**, residing in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County** in 1885, with wife Bergit and son Nils.
- Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) was born in **1875** and lived in **Polk County**, with wife Inger — none of this matches.
- This record appears to belong to **KD96-WX7** (a different Christian Hole, born 1852, resident in Aurdal, died 1919).
- **Next step:** Detach this source from KD96-TV2 and attach it to KD96-WX7 instead.

---

### ✅ Agreeing — No Finding
- **"United States Census, 1900"** — Residence in Fairview, Polk, Minnesota fits the profile; household (wife Inger, son Ole C.) matches. A two-year birth-year drift in the index (1877 vs. 1875) is within normal census variance and was not flagged.

### ⚠️ Could Not Fully Check
- **"Hole family photograph and funeral card" (uploaded memory)** — Gives death in Erskine, 1945, which agrees with the profile, but uploaded memories often just copy the tree, so it doesn't independently corroborate the date. Worth comparing against the death certificate (Finding 1).

---

### Sourcing Gap
- The **1898 marriage has no source** attached to it.

**Bottom line:** Detach the 1885 Minnesota State Census from this profile, and investigate the Death Index year discrepancy (1954 vs. 1945) against the original death certificate.

Here is the audit of sources on **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)**, worst finding first:

---

### Finding 1 — Source-vs-Source Conflict (most serious)
**Two sources give incompatible death/burial dates:**
- **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900** → death **2 February 1885**, Sherbrooke
- **Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621–1979** → burial **14 April 1878**, St. Patrick's Cemetery

These cannot describe the same death — the burial falls **seven years before** the civil death registration. The profile carries no death date, leaving the conflict unresolved. This needs to go to the conflict-resolution workflow with both records open.

---

### Finding 2 — Likely Indexing/Transcription Error (ambiguous)
**Marriage year discrepancy:**
- **Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection)** → indexed as **9 June 1845**
- Profile records the marriage as **9 June 1849**

Same couple (Margaret Hayes), same parish (St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke), same day and month. The record image exists, so the original register page should be re-read to determine which year is correct.

---

### Finding 3 — Possible Indexing Error or Misattribution (ambiguous)
**Residence place discrepancy:**
- **Census of Canada East, 1851** → indexed residence: **Melbourne**, Canada East
- Profile records: **Sherbrooke**, Canada East

The record provides no age or household members to confirm the match beyond name and Irish birthplace. The original census page should be re-read before any action is taken. **Do not detach.**

---

### Not Findings
- Birth year 1814 agrees with christening of 12 March 1814.
- 1861 census birth year of ~1816 is ordinary census drift.
- Residence 1861 (Sherbrooke) is consistent.

---

### Could Not Check
- **Driscoll headstone photograph, St. Patrick's Cemetery** (uploaded memory) — contributor upload with no indexed record. May be a useful lead for the death/burial conflict in Finding 1.

---

### Tree Note
One place on this person is not linked to a standard/recognized place identifier — worth normalizing.

## Sources Evaluated (4 attached)

### ✅ Correct — "United States Census, 1900"
The 1900 census fits well. The household in Fairview Township, Polk County, Minnesota, with wife Inger and son Ole C. Hole all match. The birth year (1877 vs. 1875 on the profile) is ordinary census variance and is not a problem.

---

### ⚠️ Indexing Error — "Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"
The index records a death year of **1954**, but the profile records **1945** — same day (10 June), same town (Erskine, Polk County), same birth year (1875). Everything else fits; only the year differs.

This record does **not** belong to this person. It lists:
- Christian Hole, born **1852** in Norway, residence **Aurdal, Otter Tail County**
- Wife **Bergit** (born 1856), son **Nils** (born 1879)

**Next step:** Detach this source from Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2). It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### ❓ Cannot Check — "Hole family photograph and funeral card" (uploaded memory)
No indexed record is behind this attachment; it cannot be evaluated automatically.

---

- **Marriage (1 May 1898)** has no tagged bearing source.
- **Contradiction in the tree:** A residence event dated 1950 appears more than 1 year after the recorded death of 10 June 1945.
- **Unlinked places:** Several events lack a standard place link in the project tree.

Here is the source-evaluation report for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources Audit: Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)
4 sources attached · **2 findings**

---

### Finding 1 — Possible Indexing Error
**Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002**

The indexed death year is **1954**; the profile records **1945**. The day (10 June), place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota), name, and birth year (1875, Norway) all match — only the year differs, suggesting a single misread digit in the index.

**Action:** Re-read the original death certificate to confirm the year. Keep the source attached in the meantime.

---

### Finding 2 — Misattributed Source
**Minnesota State Census, 1885**

This record shows a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, residing in Aurdal, Otter Tail County, with wife **Bergit** and son **Nils**. The profile records birth **1875**, wife **Inger**, no son Nils, and no Otter Tail residence. The 23-year birth year gap is not census drift — this is a different man.

This same record is also attached to **KD96-WX7**, whose profile (birth 1852, Otter Tail 1885, death 1919) fits it correctly.

**Action:** Detach this record from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### Additional Notes
- **Birth (1900 census):** Birth year 1877 agrees within census drift — no finding.
- **Residence 1900 (Fairview, Polk):** Agrees with the 1900 census — no finding.
- **Uploaded memory item** (funeral card): No readable record ID; not evaluable.
- **Sourcing gaps** (not defects): No sources cover the 1 May 1898 marriage, the 1895/1910/1920/1930 residences, or the burial.

---

### Profile Checklist Notes
- The marriage has no tagged sources.
- The marriage place is missing a city.

The findings have been logged to the project research log (log_001).

## Source Audit — 3 Sources Checked, 2 Findings

---

**"United States Census, 1900"** — The residence in Fairview Township, Polk, Minnesota and the household fit. The birth year of 1877 (vs. the profile's 1875) is normal census birth-year drift. No action needed.

---

**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"**

- The indexed death year is **1954**; the profile records **1945**. Everything else fits: name, Erskine, Polk, Minnesota, and birth 1875 in Norway.
- **Action:** Obtain the Minnesota death certificate (1945) to confirm the correct year, then correct the index entry through FamilySearch's correction path. **Keep the source attached** — it's good evidence with one bad field.

---

### ❌ Finding 2 — Misattributed Source
**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"**

- The indexed record names Christian Hole, born **1852** in Norway, with wife **Bergit** and son **Nils**, residing in Aurdal, Otter Tail County, Minnesota. The profile records birth **1875** (23 years off — far beyond census drift) and wife **Inger**. The household does not match.
- This record is also attached to **KD96-WX7** (a different Christian Hole, born 1852, Aurdal, died 1919) — and fits that profile well.
- **Action:** **Detach this source from KD96-TV2.** It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### ℹ️ Could Not Verify
**Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)** — A contributor upload with no record ID. Its citation dates the funeral card to 1945, but that is the uploader's text, not independent corroboration. Use it only as a lead alongside the death certificate.

---

### Additional Notes
- **Sourcing gaps:** No sources cover residences in 1895, 1910, 1920, or 1930, or any burial record.
- **Missing from the profile:** Marriage has no tagged sources; a marriage place is missing a city.

---

The audit has been logged as **log_001** in `research.json` at the project path.
